mapper.select:
SELECT d.id AS id, d.job_name AS jobName, d.job_desc AS jobDesc, d.mode AS mode, d.job_type AS jobType, d.task_type AS taskType, d.client_id AS clientId, d.job_version AS jobVersion, d.source_type AS sourceType, d.source_table AS sourceTable, d.source_datasource_id AS sourceDatasourceId, d.sink_datasource_id AS sinkDatasourceId, d.sink_type AS sinkType, d.sink_table AS sinkTable, d.release_state AS releaseState, d.create_user_id AS createUserId, d.update_user_id AS updateUserId, d.create_time AS createTime, d.update_time AS updateTime,
s.id AS scheduleId, CASE WHEN s.execution_mode IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN s.cron_expression IS NULL OR TRIM(s.cron_expression) = '' THEN 'MANUAL' ELSE 'AUTO' END ELSE s.execution_mode END AS executionMode, s.cron_expression AS cronExpression, s.schedule_status AS scheduleStatus, s.last_schedule_time AS lastScheduleTime, s.next_schedule_time AS nextScheduleTime, s.schedule_config AS scheduleConfig,
i.job_status AS lastJobStatus, i.start_time AS lastStartTime, i.end_time AS lastEndTime, i.error_message AS errorMessage, i.run_mode AS runMode, i.id AS instanceId, i.engine_job_id AS engineJobId,
CASE WHEN i.start_time IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN i.end_time IS NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, i.start_time, NOW()) ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, i.start_time, i.end_time) END AS duration,
(IFNULL(m.read_qps, 0) + IFNULL(m.write_qps, 0)) AS qps, m.read_row_count AS readRowCount, m.write_row_count AS writeRowCount, m.read_qps AS readQps, m.write_qps AS writeQps, m.record_delay AS recordDelay,
ds_source.name AS sourceDatasourceName, ds_sink.name AS sinkDatasourceName
FROM (
SELECT d0.*, i0.id AS latest_instance_id FROM t_seatunnel_web_job_definition d0 LEFT JOIN t_seatunnel_web_job_instance i0 ON i0.id = ( SELECT t1.id FROM t_seatunnel_web_job_instance t1 WHERE t1.job_definition_id = d0.id ORDER BY t1.create_time DESC, t1.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
AND d0.id = #{dto.id}
AND d0.job_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.jobName}, '%')
AND d0.create_time >= #{dto.createTimeStart}
AND d0.create_time <= #{dto.createTimeEnd}
AND d0.source_type = #{dto.sourceType}
AND d0.sink_type = #{dto.sinkType}
AND ( CASE WHEN d0.task_type IS NOT NULL THEN d0.task_type WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(d0.mode, '')) = 'FILE_SYNC' THEN 'FILE_TRANSFER' WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(d0.job_type, '')) = 'STREAMING' THEN 'STREAM' WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(d0.mode, '')) = 'GUIDE_SINGLE' AND UPPER(COALESCE(d0.source_type, '')) IN ('WEB_UPLOAD', 'FILE_RESOURCE', 'LOCAL_FILE') THEN 'FILE_INGEST' ELSE 'BATCH' END ) = #{dto.taskType}
AND d0.mode = #{dto.mode}
AND (d0.mode IS NULL OR d0.mode != #{dto.excludeMode})
AND d0.source_table LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.sourceTable}, '%')
AND d0.sink_table LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.sinkTable}, '%')
ORDER BY d0.job_name
ASC DESC , d0.id DESC
ORDER BY d0.create_time
ASC DESC , d0.id DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset} ) d LEFT JOIN t_seatunnel_web_job_instance i ON i.id = d.latest_instance_id
LEFT JOIN t_seatunnel_web_job_metrics m ON i.id = m.job_instance_id
LEFT JOIN t_seatunnel_web_job_schedule s ON d.id = s.job_definition_id
LEFT JOIN t_seatunnel_web_datasource ds_source ON d.source_datasource_id = ds_source.id
LEFT JOIN t_seatunnel_web_datasource ds_sink ON d.sink_datasource_id = ds_sink.id
ORDER BY d.job_name
ASC DESC , d.id DESC
ORDER BY d.create_time
ASC DESC , d.id DESC
